name: Hiring pipeline runner
why: Scores each batch of CVs against one guide and drafts replies, the same evidence-first sort as the screening skill.

name: Find the right candidates and write messages they answer
why: A ready search plan with first messages and a pipeline, matching the search plan and outreach skills.

name: Problem-first job description writer
why: Builds the job from the problem the hire must solve, the outcomes-first start of every role brief.

name: Plain job post drafter
why: Drafts a clear post with real requirements when you want a quick first version.

name: Interview question set maker
why: Set questions, answer signs and a scorecard for the interview stage.

name: Candidate comparison table builder
why: Puts interview notes side by side on agreed criteria for the decision meeting.

name: Candidate reply drafter
why: A clear reply or decline for one candidate at any stage, between full message runs.

name: Run fair interviews and choose the candidate on evidence
why: Interview plan, scorecards, work test and fair comparison as one guided flow.

name: Hire fairly, from job post to a checked offer letter
why: The whole hiring run from post to checked offer, like the fill-one-role workflow.

name: Hiring mistake checklist builder
why: Turns your past hiring misses into checks to run before the next offer.

name: Sales hiring scorecard builder
why: A trait scorecard with a test per trait when the role is a sales hire.

name: New hire first week planner
why: Hands over to onboarding once the offer is accepted.
